title: Capitals that moved: every capital move since 1500, and how far each went
excerpt: 184 moves of a capital since 1500, from St Petersburg to Brasília to Ciudad de la Paz. The longest was a flight: the Portuguese court, 7,716 km from Lisbon to Rio de Janeiro in 1808.
seo_description: An interactive map of every capital move since 1500: 184 moves, how far each went, purpose-built capitals, and Nusantara's status in 2026.
header_alt: Title card reading 'Capitals that moved' in black, brick red and navy on cream, beside a light world map criss-crossed by coloured arcs from old capitals to new ones, with a long dashed arc across the Atlantic from Lisbon to Rio de Janeiro. Text: 184 moves of a capital since 1500; the longest, Lisbon to Rio de Janeiro, 7,716 km, in 1808.
